UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user within the DevTalk application, storing their profile information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

displayName.description: The name displayed for the user in the application.

email.description: The user's email address, used for contact and potentially login (though authentication is external).

avatarUrl.description: URL to the user's profile avatar image.

Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Represents a collaborative environment where users can interact through channels and direct messages.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Workspace entity.

description.description: A brief description of the workspace's purpose or focus.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the workspace was created.

ownerId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created and owns this workspace. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Workspace)

memberIds.description: References to UserProfiles who are members of this workspace. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Workspace)

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: Represents a communication channel within a specific workspace, which can be public or private.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Channel entity.

workspaceId.description: Reference to the Workspace this channel belongs to. (Relationship: Workspace 1:N Channel)

description.description: A brief description of the channel's topic or purpose.

isPrivate.description: Indicates whether the channel is private (true) or public (false).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the channel was created.

creatorId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created this channel. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Channel)

memberIds.description: References to UserProfiles who are members of this channel. Required for private channels. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Channel)

Huddle.title: Huddle
Huddle.description: Represents an active video/voice huddle session within a channel.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Huddle session.

participantIds.description: List of user IDs currently in the huddle.

DirectMessageConversation.title: DirectMessageConversation
DirectMessageConversation.description: Represents a private one-on-one conversation between two users within a workspace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DirectMessageConversation entity.

workspaceId.description: Reference to the Workspace in which this direct message conversation occurs. (Relationship: Workspace 1:N DirectMessageConversation)

participantIds.description: References to the two UserProfiles participating in this conversation. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N DirectMessageConversation)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the direct message conversation was initiated.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message sent within a channel or a direct message conversation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

senderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent this message. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Message)

content.description: The rich text content of the message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

channelId.description: Reference to the Channel this message belongs to. Only one of 'channelId' or 'directMessageConversationId' should be present. (Relationship: Channel 1:N Message)

directMessageConversationId.description: Reference to the DirectMessageConversation this message belongs to. Only one of 'channelId' or 'directMessageConversationId' should be present. (Relationship: DirectMessageConversation 1:N Message)

editedAt.description: Timestamp when the message was last edited, if applicable.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: The unique identifier of the workspace.

definition.description: Active huddle session for a channel.
